First, convert 30 weeks and 2 days into days:  
30 weeks × 7 days/week = 210 days  
210 days + 2 days = 212 days to subtract.

Start date: 1304-02-25  
Subtract 212 days:  
1304 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not century exception because 1300 not divisible by 400? Actually 1300 not leap, but 1304 is leap).  
From 1304-02-25 back 25 days → 1304-01-31.  
Remaining 212 − 25 = 187 days to go back into 1303.  
1303 is not leap, so from 1304-01-01 back 1 day → 1303-12-31, then back 186 more days.  
December 1303 has 31 days, so back 31 days → 1303-11-30, remaining 155 days.  
November: 30 days → 1303-10-31, remaining 125 days.  
October: 31 days → 1303-09-30, remaining 94 days.  
September: 30 days → 1303-08-31, remaining 64 days.  
August: 31 days → 1303-07-31, remaining 33 days.  
July: 31 days → 1303-06-30, remaining 2 days.  
Back 2 more days → 1303-06-28.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1303-06-28
